videos.subtitle_summary:
The user wants me to summarize a YouTube video caption in Korean, around 500 characters, using 3-5 sentences. The caption contains news about:
1. A fire/explosion at Hwahae Aerospace (하화 에로스페이스) with 7 casualties - police and fire authorities conducting joint investigation since 10 AM, suspected to be during cleaning of rocket equipment but all possibilities being considered.
2. Local elections and by-elections campaign ending at midnight today - Democratic Party pushing for judgment on incompetent local power, People Power Party appealing for votes to prevent local power from going to ruling party.
3. Trump saying he could reach agreement with Iran within a week, and actively mediating Israel-Hezbollah conflict.
4. Consumer prices rose 3.1% last month due to US-Iran war effects - highest increase in 2 years and 2 months since March 2024, high prices expected to continue.
I need to summarize this in Korean only, no English, around 500 characters, 3-5 sentences.
